title: New Shuffle Along with Sissle and Blake
summary: The new Shuffle Along featured Sissle and Blake and Buck and Bubbles; Chuck and Chuckles were on the bill as a separate act with a script.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But Chuck and Chuckles never performed in any Sissle and Blake musicals, did they?
Yes. Well, that was part of it, you
see, because the new Shuffle Along was -- he featured them in that. Noble Sissle and Blake was in the new Shuffle Along and Buck and Bubbles also, see?

Well, yes, you could say that. They were Chuck and Chuckles. We worked together, and when we became Chuck and Chuckles, our paths crossed, and that was one of the times. Our paths crossed, where we were on the same bill as Buck and Bubbles. But we were like a separate act at that time. We weren't just in their act. And that was Shuffle Along, you had a script. You had to play parts.
